title: Issue #1939 execution
intent: Livelock fix pinned and both starvation directions verified in CI; PR #4197 Draft, awaiting #4185 to land before the blocks() rebase
progress_summary: SPEC #1939 Phase 71 T-IDX-436/437 in Draft PR #4197 (b8f79531d). Production half (3de8bf643): search-multi now claims the host-wide heavy lease at interactive priority - it previously took none, so AS-30's one-runner-tree rule was untrue and a search could never preempt a background build; the interactive exemption is bounded by heavy.burst.json; and the v2 base/overlay build now checkpoints every 16 documents, yields, and resumes from the Embedding CAS. Test half (b8f79531d, no production change): the stand-aside livelock is pinned by a test that fails without the fix - RED quoted from the one-sided run (22 passed / 1 failed at 'the queued background continuation must have taken the slot'), GREEN in CI - and rewritten so it detects a never-served claimant rather than a slow one. Both starvation directions are now covered: background gets >= 2 turns under 24 back-to-back searches, and the search that stands aside is served immediately after. CI green on b8f79531d: Test (Rust), Test (Rust, Windows), Test (Python runner), Clippy & Rustfmt all SUCCESS; no cli/daemon/server.rs failure so #4199 did not bite. Analysed the composition with #4185's arrival-order queue and handed #4169 the exact both-sides QueueRecord::blocks shape plus a waiting_above refinement. Remaining: rebase onto #4185 after it lands; no structural change to acquire_heavy_inner will be pushed before then.
